Test Test Sign Out Club Systems Member [redacted-name] Mapping Warning: 'Enable Member [redacted-name] Synchronisation' is disabled. BRS member [redacted-name] will NOT synchronise with Club Systems member [redacted-name]. You can still choose to include/exclude Club Systems member [redacted-name]. This tool maps Club Systems member [redacted-name] to BRS member [redacted-name]. This allows you to create one BRS member [redacted-name], representing one or more Club Systems member [redacted-name]. It is useful to create Club Systems Member [redacted-name] Maps when member [redacted-name] is imported from other sources. The Club Systems member [redacted-name] may include billing categories, rather than playing categories, which are not best suited for tee time management. The table below illustrates which mappings have already been configured. When Club Systems data is first imported, a BRS member [redacted-name] is created with the same name as the Club Systems member [redacted-name]. Initially, all Club Systems member [redacted-name] will be included and all imported members will be marked as enabled. These settings can be changed by editing any entry listed below. Club Systems Member [redacted-name]: The member [redacted-name] as specified in the Club Systems software and/or imported data file. BRS Member [redacted-name]: The member [redacted-name], as specified in this BRS tee time management software. Member [redacted-name] can be used to define what sort of player [redacted-name] is and can be used to filter their booking options. Include Club Systems Member [redacted-name]: This defines whether members of the specified Club Systems category will be imported into BRS. Any existing non-registered members will also be removed from BRS, if their Club Systems category is not marked as included. Mark Members as Disabled in BRS: When a mapping is marked as disabled, any members being imported with this category will be marked as disabled. This will prevent them from logging in and/or making any bookings. Import Club Systems Member [redacted-name]: If Club Systems synchronisation has been configured, any Club Systems member [redacted-name] will be imported automatically, when this button is clicked. entries.title: Club Systems Member [redacted-name] Preview
entries.content: [redacted-club] Dashboard Timesheet Messages Golf Plus NEW! Facilities Contacts Users Reports Search Tools Need Help? Test Test Sign Out Club Systems Member [redacted-name] Preview BRS and Club Systems Joint Statement This tool helps you to merge data to and from the BRS tee time booking system with other systems. The left hand column has the Club Systems member [redacted-name], the midde column has the current BRS member [redacted-name] and the right hand column shows what the BRS member [redacted-name] will be after the update. Different fields are colour coded in different ways, depending on their status. These are as follows: Update/Add When the record will be added or updated in BRS. Disable When the record will be disabled in BRS. Fault When there is a fault which means the BRS record cannot be added/updated. Warning When there is an inconsistency with the Club Systems data and/or a record cannot be updated. Different When the BRS value is different from the Club Systems value, but may not be updated.
